places.editorial: A minimal Japanese coffee bar with beans roasted in-house and a small terrace at the heart of East London.

places.name: Abuelo
places.editorial: A warm Australian–South American café for thoughtful coffee, colourful brunch plates and an unhurried city pause. Well-behaved dogs are welcome, with no other restrictions specified by the team. Photography: @abuelocafeuk

places.name: Workshop Coffee
places.editorial: A light-filled café and coffee academy serving seasonal single origins, an all-day menu and evening aperitivo. Dogs are welcome. Photography: @workshopcoffee

places.name: WOLFOX Savoy London
places.editorial: A grand café just off the Strand, with pale walls, generous windows and speciality coffee. Come for a slow breakfast before a walk along the river. Well-behaved dogs welcome. Photography: @wolfoxsavoylondon, used with permission.

places.name: Nagare Coffee · Soho

places.name: The Laslett
places.editorial: A quiet Notting Hill base across five Victorian townhouses, with art-filled rooms, books and a neighbourhood bar. A considered city stay moments from Notting Hill Gate. Dogs welcome. Contact the hotel before booking for the applicable pet terms. Photography: @thelaslett, used with permission.

places.name: WatchHouse Fitzrovia
places.editorial: Dark oak booths, stainless steel counters and carefully made coffee in an understated Fitzrovia space, with brunch and fresh bakes. Dog-friendly, as listed by WatchHouse.

places.name: Bow Wow London
places.shortDescription: Dog shop · Central London · Covent Garden
places.editorial: A Seven Dials boutique with considered accessories, toys and treats, alongside a dedicated grooming salon.

places.name: Love My Human
places.editorial: The King’s Road boutique brings together beautifully made dog accessories, beds, toys and grooming essentials.

places.name: Dogeast

places.name: Big City Dog

places.name: Mello World

places.name: George’s Dog Boutique

places.name: Yeni

places.name: Granger & Co · Marylebone
places.editorial: An Australian-inspired neighbourhood restaurant for breakfast, lunch and dinner, with a warm dining room on Marylebone High Street. Small, well-behaved dogs are welcome. Keep them on a lead, on the floor and close to you. Photography: @grangerandco

places.name: Studio Coffee
places.editorial: A vinyl-led coffee shop and cocktail bar on Bedford Street, pairing coffee and pastries with a soundtrack that invites you to stay awhile. Dogs are welcome. Photography: @studiocoffee__

places.name: Paradox Design + Coffee

places.name: Leigh’s
places.editorial: A neighbourhood coffee stop in De Beauvoir for cakes, toasties and seasonal drinks, with a busy counter and a warm welcome for local dogs. Dogs are welcome. Please keep reactive dogs on a lead. Photography: @leighslondon

places.name: Estate Office Coffee
places.editorial: A local coffee shop on Greyhound Lane for coffee and sourdough toasties, with a Polaroid wall celebrating its four-legged regulars. Dogs are welcome. Photography: @estateofficecoffee

places.name: Canteen
places.editorial: A walk-in neighbourhood restaurant on Portobello Road, with a changing menu and tables for a leisurely lunch or evening meal. Dogs are welcome. Photography: @canteen.310

places.name: EVE Kensington
places.editorial: A richly coloured café at Ember Locke, with pastries, coffee and a relaxed setting for a Kensington pause. Dogs are welcome. Photography: @evekensington

places.name: Scenery
places.editorial: A coffee roastery and café at Jerwood Space, with a glass-roofed courtyard, coffee roasted on site and a kitchen serving breakfast, lunch and Saturday brunch. Dogs are welcome on a lead. Water bowls and complimentary dog treats are available. Photography: @scenerycoffeeroasters

places.name: Paper & Cup
places.shortDescription: Vintage & takeaway coffee · East London · Shoreditch
places.editorial: A community-minded stop on Calvert Avenue, now focused on vintage and second-hand clothing, with specialty coffee to take away. Purchases support Spitalfields Crypt Trust. Dogs are welcome. Primarily a second-hand clothing shop with takeaway coffee. Photography: @paperandcupshoreditch

places.name: Ozone Coffee · Shoreditch
places.editorial: A Leonard Street coffee stop for espresso, rotating filter coffees and seasonal breakfast or lunch, just around the corner from Old Street. Dogs are welcome at all Ozone cafés. Photography: @ozonecoffeeuk

places.name: Qima Café · Fitzrovia
places.editorial: A Fitzrovia café pairing carefully sourced coffee with pâtisserie and brunch. Its tree-to-cup approach connects the coffee served here with the farmers behind it. Dogs are welcome at both Qima cafés, with no restrictions or additional fees. Photography: @qima.cafe

plans.title: A Slow Morning in Montmartre
plans.character: Coffee, neighbourhood streets and a thoughtful stop for your dog.
plans.intro: A gentle Montmartre morning with time for good coffee, a neighbourhood wander and places chosen for both of you.
stopNotes: Begin with coffee while the neighbourhood is still settling into the day.
Continue towards Rue des Martyrs for a second coffee or something baked.
Make a considered stop for your dog before walking north through Montmartre.
Finish with a relaxed late breakfast or lunch nearby.

plans.title: An Afternoon in Le Marais
plans.character: Specialty coffee, dog shops and an early evening table.
plans.intro: A compact route through the quieter edges of Le Marais, moving from coffee to dog-focused shops and an easy early dinner.
stopNotes: Start with a carefully made coffee before heading east.
Continue to a dog café and boutique made around life together.
Close the afternoon with an early table in the heart of Le Marais.

plans.title: A Golden Hour Along the Seine
plans.character: A riverside walk, an unhurried pause and dinner as Paris turns golden.
plans.intro: A gentle late-afternoon route along the Seine, moving through the Left Bank with time to pause before an early dinner.
stopNotes: Begin with something carefully made before walking towards the river.
Finish with an early dinner as the light softens over Paris.

plans.title: A Sunday in Saint-Germain
plans.character: Coffee, old streets, a garden pause and a long lunch together.
plans.intro: A relaxed Sunday around Saint-Germain, designed for wandering slowly between coffee, quiet streets and a generous lunch.
stopNotes: Start slowly with coffee and something baked.
Browse one thoughtful stop chosen with your dog in mind.
End with a long, easy lunch before heading home.
